svg.title: Diaphragm: domes and inferior view
svg.desc: Left panel: anterior coronal cutaway of the thorax. The diaphragm is a dome-shaped muscle sheet arching up into the chest beneath the lungs, with the right dome higher than the left; its muscular periphery attaches to the lower ribs and the pale central tendon forms the apex. Right panel: inferior view showing the central tendon, caval and esophageal openings, aortic opening between the crura, and the muscular periphery.
